obstruction: Every pair of incident Q6 directions spans a square; in a Cartesian product of cycles of length >=5 every simple 4-cycle is a rectangle using two distinct factors. Thus six incident Q6 edges require six distinct factors.

parity_homomorphism.interpretation: Valid homomorphism, but collapses all six Q6 directions to one edge.

scope: Graph-theoretic result only; no physical or transport equivalence.
